effects.tier2: 10 damage; the griffon [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to 2 squares
effects.tier3: 13 damage; the griffon [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to 3 squares

effects.effect: If this ability is used as part of the Charge main action, the griffon can [grab](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) one of the targets.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The griffon must be flying and must have a creature or object [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed).
effects.name: Special

effects.effect: The griffon flies up to half their speed toward the ground, then sends the creature or object they've [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) hurtling down. The creature or object hits the ground to turn the area into an impact crater, and takes falling damage that can't be reduced in any way.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: A target object must be size 2 or smaller.
effects.name: Special

features.name: Wing Buffet
features.target: Each creature or object in the area

effects.effect: The griffon halves the damage, ignores any nondamaging effects associated with it, and [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to 2 squares.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: While [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) by the griffon, a creature has a double bane on the Escape Grab maneuver.
Any power roll that could knock the griffon or their rider [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) takes a bane.

effects.tier2: 11 damage; one target is [pushed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 2 squares; the other target is vertical [pushed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 2 squares
effects.tier3: 14 damage; one target is [pushed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 2 squares and knocked [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone); the other target is vertical [pushed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 3 squares

effects.effect: The griffon [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to their speed along the ground in straight line. Each enemy who comes [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to the griffon during this shift can choose to either take 5 damage or be knocked [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone).
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Power Wing Buffet
features.target: Each creature or object in the area

effects.effect: The griffon dives down onto the target, taking no damage from falling if they reach the ground. The target takes 3 damage for each square the griffon dove, and if they have A < 2, they are [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) or knocked [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone).
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Circle and Strike
features.trigger: The griffon flies directly above a creature within distance.

effects.effect: While [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) by the griffon, a creature has a double bane on the Escape Grab maneuver.
Any power roll that could knock the griffon [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) takes a bane.
The griffon can attempt hide even while observed. Additionally, while no enemy has line of effect to them, the griffon can attempt to hide at the end of their turn.
